WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_v1 AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dr.d_date AS d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
            ORDER BY dr.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_range AS dr
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_v1 AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dr.d_date AS d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
            ORDER BY dr.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_range AS dr
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM web_v1
    UNION
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM store_v1
),
x AS (
    SELECT
        ad.item_sk,
        ad.d_date,
        w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
        s.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM all_dates AS ad
    LEFT JOIN web_v1 AS w
      ON ad.item_sk = w.item_sk AND ad.d_date = w.d_date
    LEFT JOIN store_v1 AS s
      ON ad.item_sk = s.item_sk AND ad.d_date = s.d_date
),
y AS (
    SELECT
        x.item_sk,
        x.d_date,
        x.web_sales,
        x.store_sales,
        (SELECT MAX(w.cume_sales)
         FROM web_v1 AS w
         WHERE w.item_sk = x.item_sk
           AND w.d_date <= x.d_date
        ) AS web_cumulative,
        (SELECT MAX(s.cume_sales)
         FROM store_v1 AS s
         WHERE s.item_sk = x.item_sk
           AND s.d_date <= x.d_date
        ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM x
)
SELECT
    item_sk,
    d_date,
    web_sales,
    store_sales,
    web_cumulative,
    store_cumulative
FROM y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
